title: I Beg To Differ
summary:
For example, a common refrain at the time was,
you can't be fired for buying IBM, the era's quintessential growth company. Thus, if investors lack insight that is superior to the average of the people who make up the
consensus, they should expect average risk-adjusted performance. Thus, every active bet
placed in the pursuit of above-average returns carries with it the risk of below-average returns.
